nom: Drunk Elephant Mello Marula Cream Cleanser

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin uses it only as a light first cleanse before a stronger foaming cleanser, not as a standalone solution.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry to very dry skin repeatedly describe it as hydrating and non-stripping, though one review calls it tight, dry and stinging on her dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: some report reduced redness and no dryness, while one with fair combination skin reports worsening breakouts and another with combination skin and rosacea reports dryness and itching.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most numerous and consistently report gentleness, no irritation, and no stripping, including several with eczema, rosacea, or seborrheic dermatitis who describe calming effects.
segments.mature: The two reviewers who mention mature or middle-aged skin report the cleanser is not drying and works well alongside anti-aging routines.

concerns.aging: Two mature-skin reviewers report the cleanser is gentle and non-drying, with one noting an antioxidant boost from marula oil; no one reports dedicated anti-aging results.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, report the cleanser leaves skin hydrated and never tight or stripped; one dissenting review says it feels tight, dry and stingy afterward.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea, seborrheic dermatitis, or general redness report visible calming and reduced redness after use; no negative reports on redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers recovering from over-exfoliation, chemical peels, or eczema flare-ups report the cleanser felt soothing and did not disrupt their skin barrier.
concerns.spots: No reviewer specifically discusses spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or combination skin report no new breakouts and some improvement; one reviewer reports repeated worsening breakouts after two to three uses.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin uses it only as a gentle pre-cleanse, implying it does not address oil control alone; no other reviewer discusses oil control.

aspects.libelle: Creamy, non-foaming or lightly lathering texture
Leaves skin soft and hydrated after rinsing
May not fully remove heavy makeup or waterproof mascara without double cleansing
Can feel tight or stinging on some dry/sensitive skin

extraits.texte: I got a sample of this product with an order recently. I've used it two or three times and my breakout just gets worse each time. In the past I have tried this (or a similar Drunk Elephant cleanser) years ago with the same result. I had to check that it was actually a cleanser because it really just felt like cream melting into my skin. It smells nice but I can't continue using it. I'm 35, have very fair combination skin and minimal issues with breakouts when I use the right cleanser (Cetaphil, Origins).
I have combination skin with rosacea. I bought this to see if it would help with a flare up. The cleanser isn't bad but it dries my skin out and makes it itch. Not for me.

extraits.titre: Perhaps not the best for dry skin
extraits.texte: This is a nice cleanser, but it doesn't leave my face a comfortable as I'd like. It feels tight and dry, and a little itchy/sting-y. It feels immediately when I apply my smoothy, so it all works out, but ultimately I'd prefer something a little more soothing.
Thick, creamy, smells lovely, and has a rich lather to it that calms my rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis without irritating my dry, sensitive, acne-prone skin. Overall, this is my dream cleanser.

extraits.titre: First cleanser to actually calm my breakouts and rosacea!
extraits.texte: I usually don't write reviews but this cleanser is seriously AMAZING i need to tell everyone about it. I have acne prone- combination skin and i suffer from A LOT of roseasea on my cheeks. I started using this product only 3 days ago and my acne is GONE and my redness is clearing up. I pair this with nivea cream jn the tin. Amazing combo!!! I am SO pleased with the results.

I have dry, mature skin. I was a little worried whether this cleanser would remove makeup and sunscreen, but it worked really well! I even used on vacation to shave my legs. Overall very pleased with this product!

Love using this as my first cleanse at night after a long day and occasionally in the mornings because it's light and gentle. I have oily acne prone skin and need a heavy cleanser so I'll always use a lighter cleanser first before using my foaming cleanser. This was gifted to me by drunk elephant in exchange for an honest review.
